phases.label: Levels 1-3
goals: Trade with autos so your passive and Q heal you, and keep your HP above theirs.
Hit level 2 and 3 first; Warwick wins short all-ins once E and Q are both up.
Farm toward your first back with 900+ gold.
do: Skill Q level 1, W at 2, E at 3 (max Q, then W, then E).
Auto the enemy whenever it is safe: Eternal Hunger heals you more the lower you are.
Trade with auto, Q (hold it to stick to them), auto, then walk out; fight longer once they drop under 50% HP.
Level 3 all-in: Q, autos, then recast E to fear when they try to leave.
Blood Hunt gives you bonus attack speed automatically against targets below 50% HP: that is your kill window.
dont: Don't fight ranged poke champions from range; farm under your turret and wait for a gank or level 3.
Don't waste E early just to fear; it is your escape and your finisher.
Don't chase a kiting champion past your wave without Q ready.
ifAhead: Force trades and zone them off CS; a low target is an easy kill with Q and Blood Hunt.
Crash the wave into their turret for plates before your first back.
ifEven: Farm, take auto trades when their key spell is down, and play for level 3.
Keep the wave near the middle so the enemy jungler cannot easily catch you.
ifBehind: Let the wave come to you and farm under your turret; heal with autos on minions.
Keep E up as your escape and wait for level 6.

phases.label: Levels 4-5
goals: Recall on a crashed wave with 900+ gold and start Blade of The Ruined King.
Stay even in CS and levels so your top quest and level 6 arrive on time.
Keep Q and E up as an answer to the enemy jungler.
do: Crash the wave before you recall so you lose no CS.
Buy Vampiric Scepter or Recurve Bow toward Blade of The Ruined King, plus a Control Ward with leftovers.
Trade with autos when you are on the bigger wave; the heal from autos wins long trades.
Join a dragon fight only if your jungler starts it and you can arrive first.
dont: Don't walk up in their ranged poke range with low HP.
Don't play far from your turret without a ward; Warwick cannot escape a gank without E or Q.
ifAhead: Slow push and force trades; kill them once they drop below 50% HP.
Ping your jungler for a gank from your side when the enemy is low.
ifEven: Farm and trade autos; save E for a gank or a kill.
Hold the wave near your side and keep your HP high.
ifBehind: Farm under your turret and buy Vampiric Scepter for sustain.
Wait for level 6 and a jungler visit.

phases.label: Level 6 to first item
goals: Threaten kills with Infinite Duress: R the enemy when they are below half HP or out of position.
Finish Blade of The Ruined King and your top quest around 12-13 minutes.
Join Voidgrubs at 8:00 with your jungler when your wave is crashed.
do: Kill combo: Q, autos, R when they turn to run, then recast E to fear after the suppression.
R range scales with your movement speed: Blood Hunt speed toward a low target makes it reach further.
Push the wave, then use Blood Hunt's active out of combat to find a low target mid or in the river.
Join Voidgrubs at 8:00 if your wave is crashed and you can arrive first.
dont: Don't use R on a full-HP target in front of their team; the suppression ends and you are stuck there.
Don't leave the lane with a big wave coming to your turret unless the roam kills something.
Don't R into a stun or knock-up that can interrupt you.
ifAhead: Roam for a kill mid with R and Blood Hunt, then return to your lane to take plates.
Take the top turret quickly; melee champions deal extra damage to turrets.
ifEven: Push the wave, then use R to gank when you see the enemy laner low or overextended.
Trade with autos in lane and use R only for a sure kill.
ifBehind: Farm safely toward Blade of The Ruined King; avoid fights until the item.
R is only for a safe pick when their laner is low, not to fix a losing lane.

phases.label: First item to ~14 minutes
goals: Use Blade of The Ruined King to duel and to shred tanks with percent HP damage.
Buy Plated Steelcaps next, then Stridebreaker.
Set up the 15:00 Rift Herald and use your quest Teleport for a pick.
do: Duel when the enemy is below 50% HP: Blood Hunt attack speed plus Blade of The Ruined King melts them.
Push top before Herald so your jungler can take it; hit the top turret with the Eye of the Herald.
Hold your quest Teleport for a bot fight or a gank on a low target with R.
Buy a Control Ward at every back and put it in the river or tri-brush.
dont: Don't Teleport into a fight that is already over before you land.
Don't fight the enemy top into their jungler without a ward on their approach.
ifAhead: Take the top turret and rotate to help your jungler with dragon or Herald.
Look for kills on anyone below 50% HP: Blood Hunt makes them hard to escape you.
ifEven: Push, then join Herald and use Teleport for a pick or a dragon fight.
Duel when Q, E and R are up and their escape is used.
ifBehind: Farm safely and get Plated Steelcaps versus AD or Mercury's Treads versus heavy AP and CC.
Use Teleport to join team fights instead of fighting alone.

phases.label: Midgame
goals: Push a side wave, then join your team and pick off their carry with R before each objective.
Build Stridebreaker, then Death's Dance or Sterak's Gage.
Be at Baron at 20:00 with Teleport ready or already in position.
do: Hunt the enemy carry: wait in fog or jungle, then R the target and fear with E for a free pick.
Push a side wave first, then join the objective when it starts; use Teleport to land next to your team.
Duel a lone side laner when he drops below 50% HP.
Use Stridebreaker's active (dash and slow) on a runner, then R when you are close.
Ping your team before you go for a pick so they follow up.
dont: Don't split push without vision; Warwick has no safe escape once caught.
Don't walk first into 5v5 fights; you are a flanker, not the front line.
Don't use R on a tank; keep it for a carry.
ifAhead: Force fights around dragons and Baron and R the carry as soon as the fight starts.
Take plates and turrets with your team; your healing lets you fight 1v2 when they are low.
ifEven: Stay near your team, push a wave and arrive first at each objective.
Wait in the fog for a target below 50% HP, then R.
ifBehind: Farm, avoid solo fights, and follow your team to fights from the side.
Buy Death's Dance to survive burst and heal back from kills.

phases.label: Lategame
goals: Pick off the enemy carry with R and let your team take Baron or Elder.
Play in fog with your team and only fight when you can reach the carry.
Don't die first; death timers are long now.
do: Finish with Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage or Guardian Angel if you get focused.
Stack Blade of The Ruined King's three hits on the carry after the R.
Wait for their CC to be used, then R the carry or the mage and fear with E.
Hold Q to stick to a target that dashes or flashes away; you follow their movement.
Buy Chempunk Chainsword or Thornmail for Grievous Wounds against heavy healers.
dont: Don't stand alone in the jungle; enemies with CC kill you.
Don't R into their frontline; it wastes the ultimate and takes you out of the fight.
ifAhead: Hunt the carry each fight; then take turrets and Baron with your team.
Split only if your team has vision and you win the duel.
ifEven: Group for Baron and Elder and flank to the enemy backline.
Save R for the enemy who would otherwise kill your team.
ifBehind: Stay with your team, peel with E fear, and R their assassin when he jumps in.
Play for picks on their lone side laner instead of 5v5.

trading: Trade with autos: Eternal Hunger heals you on every hit, much more below 50% and 25% HP.
Short trade: auto, Q (hold it to stick to him), auto, then walk away.
Blood Hunt passive gives you attack speed against anyone below 50% HP: that is when you commit.
E reduces damage while active; recast after a moment to fear him off you or to stop his escape.
Best all-in: Q, autos, keep E for his counter-engage or his escape, and stay on him.
Don't trade long when the enemy has Grievous Wounds; your sustain drops a lot.
Vs ranged: farm and heal with autos; Q only to catch him after he uses his key spell.
waveManagement: Your sustain lets you stay on the wave; slow push when you are stronger and fight on the bigger wave.
Crash the wave before every recall and before every objective (dragon 5:00, grubs 8:00, Herald 15:00, Baron 20:00).
Keep the wave near your tower in a bad matchup; give up CS instead of a fight you cannot win.
When ahead, push the wave into the enemy turret for plates before you roam.
Plates are permanent on all turrets; hit them for role quest points (top: +40 per plate).

when: When the enemy top cannot beat you 1v1 and your team can hold without you.
When the next objective is on the other side and your Teleport is up.
rules: Warwick is not a pure split pusher: push a wave, take a plate or turret, then rotate back to your team.
If one enemy comes, fight him once he drops below 50% HP; if two come, walk away and let your team take something.
Keep a ward in the jungle to see them come; you can't escape without E or Q.
Use Stridebreaker's dash to move fast between waves.
tpUsage: Save Teleport for a fight or a pick with R at Baron or dragon.
Teleport to a ward or minion on a flank and R the carry as soon as you land.
After the quest you get a free Teleport (390 s cooldown at 26.19) or an upgraded one; plan your plays around it.

teamfight.role: Flanking diver and pick-off: hide in fog, then R the enemy carry, and heal by attacking in the fight.
rules: Wait for their CC to be used, then R the carry.
Recast E after the suppression so the carry can't walk away from you.
Blood Hunt shows anyone below 50% HP and speeds you toward them: chase those first.
Hold Q to follow a target through dashes and Flash.
Stay with your team if their carry is not reachable; fight the closest low-HP enemy.
targetPriority: The enemy carry you can reach with R.
The mage or assassin who is out of position.
Anyone below 50% HP (Blood Hunt shows them).

objectives: Dragon spawns at 5:00 (respawn 5:00); Elder comes 6:00 after the fourth drake. Crash top first so you can Teleport.
Voidgrubs: 3 at 8:00, despawn 14:45; help take them after you crash your wave.
Rift Herald: 15:00, despawns 19:45; push top first, then use the Eye on the top turret.
Baron: 20:00, then 6:00 after each kill; be alive and near with Teleport up. R the carry that tries to steal.
Atakhan was removed in 2026; plan around Baron and dragons.
Plates are permanent on inner and inhibitor turrets too; push waves with your team when you are ahead.
mechanics: Q (Jaws of the Beast): tap to bite and heal; hold it to attach and follow the target's dashes, then land behind them.
W (Blood Hunt): passive attack speed against targets below 50% HP and move speed toward them; the active (out of combat) marks the nearest enemy.
E (Primal Howl): damage reduction for up to 2.75 s, then a fear; recast after 1 s to fear early.
R (Infinite Duress): long leap that suppresses the first champion hit; range scales with your move speed; hard CC stops the leap.
Eternal Hunger: every auto heals you below 50% HP, and far more below 25%; Grievous Wounds cut it a lot.
Blade of The Ruined King: three hits on a champion slow them and steal their move speed.

recallTimings.note: Minimum back: attack speed toward Blade of The Ruined King.
Sustain back: lifesteal toward Blade of The Ruined King.
Your first item; your strongest duel spike.

recallTimings.buy: Plated Steelcaps (vs AD) or Mercury's Treads (vs AP or CC)
recallTimings.note: Right after Blade of The Ruined King.
Second legendary; dash, slow and move speed for R.
Third: Death's Dance vs AD burst, Sterak's Gage vs CC and burst.

commonMistakes: Using R on a tank or on a full-HP target.
Using E fear too early and having no answer when the target runs or engages.
Fighting champions with Grievous Wounds and heavy CC without a plan.
Chasing a kiting target far from your team.
Splitting without vision and dying to a pick.
Backing off at low HP when your passive heal would win the fight.

enemy_laner_dead: Push the wave into their turret and take plates before you recall.
Buy your components and come back, or Teleport to help your jungler.
you_died_to_gank: Ward the river and keep the wave near your turret.
Save E and Q as your escape before you walk up.
you_died_solo: Trade only when your Q and E are up and his key spell is down.
Farm under turret and play for the first item and level 6.
opp_level_lead: They are a level up; farm under your turret and don't trade.
Wait for level 3 or 6 and a jungler visit.
you_level_lead: You are a level up; trade with autos, Q and E before they catch up.
Watch for the enemy jungler first.
you_hit_level_2_first: Level 2 first: auto, Q and hold it, auto, then back out.
you_hit_6: R online: look for a kill when they are below half HP or after a push.
Check the enemy jungler before you leap.
first_item_done: Blade of The Ruined King done: duel and shred tanks; push and take the turret.
second_item_done: Two items: push side, then pick off the carry with R; join objectives with Teleport.
three_items_done: Three items: flank and R the carry, then heal and stay alive.
you_are_fed: Push waves and take turrets with your team; hunt the carry with R.
Don't walk alone without vision; your bounty is high.
you_are_behind: Farm safely, heal with autos and group with your team.
Wait for a low-HP target and pick it with R; avoid front-line fights.
enemy_laner_fed: Don't duel him; group with your team and R him when he steps up first.
Buy Plated Steelcaps or Mercury's Treads and a defensive item.
enemy_team_numbers_down: You have more players; push a turret or take the next objective now.
Crash your wave on the way.
your_team_numbers_down: Your team is down players; clear waves under your turret and don't fight.
baron_up_soon: Baron soon: push a wave and stand in fog near the pit with Teleport ready.
R the carry when the fight starts.
dragon_up_soon: Dragon soon: crash top and keep Teleport ready to join.
If you can't make it, push top to pull an enemy away.
grubs_soon: Grubs at 8:00: crash your wave and help your jungler take them.
Don't go if the enemy top and jungler will arrive first.
herald_soon: Herald at 15:00: push top first, then help take it and use the Eye on your top turret.
enemy_jungler_ganked_top_repeatedly: Keep the wave near your turret and ward the river and tri-brush.
Keep E and Q for the gank; don't spend them on a trade.
long_death_timers: Death timers are long: don't walk alone; one pick can lose Baron or the game.
Stay with your team and wait in fog.
enemy_has_heavy_healing: Heavy healing: buy Chempunk Chainsword or Thornmail; burst them so they can't heal back.
Don't trade long when your sustain is not enough.
enemy_heavy_ap: Heavy AP: buy Mercury's Treads and Spirit Visage or Maw of Malmortius.
Use E in fights to reduce damage.
enemy_heavy_ad: Heavy AD: Plated Steelcaps and Death's Dance.
Use E when the ADC and auto-attackers hit you.
enemy_many_tanks: Many tanks: Blade of The Ruined King does percent HP damage; R the carry behind them.
Don't waste R on a tank.
enemy_heavy_cc: Heavy CC: Mercury's Treads and Sterak's Gage.
Wait for their CC to be used before you R.
turret_lost: Your turret is down: don't push without vision; play near your next turret.
enemy_turret_taken: Turret taken: push the next lane or join the next objective with Teleport.
Keep hitting their inner turrets; plates stay up.
